title: Kya Aag Lagi Haaye Mohammad ke Chaman Me
body:
Kya aag lagi haye mohammed ke chaman mein karbal tere ban me, aajati hai jab yaad to hook utthi hai man mein karbal tere ban me
Pardesiyao ki aaho bhagat ka hai yahi dhang accha hai samat sung, lohe ki padi bediyaan Abid ke charan me karbal tere ban me
Batla to sahi tujh pa bhi chaya tha andhera kya waqt tha tera, chand aaya tha jab Fatima zehra ke chaman me karbal tere ban me
Bewao ki chini chadarain bachchao ke shaluke dekha kiye bhooke, phie barah galey baandhey gaye ek rasan me Abid tere ban me, paani bhi inhe milgaya ya margaye pyaase sach kehna Raza se, pradesi jo aaye the sarita ke sharan me karbal tere ban me..
